lots.title: Pair of Danish teak lounge chairs
lots.note: Reupholstered in oatmeal wool by the previous owner; original teak frames with the maker's brand under the front rail. Light ring-mark on the left arm, photographed in detail.

lots.title: Victorian mourning brooch, seed pearl and jet
lots.note: Woven hair panel intact under glass. Pin and safety catch original and working. One seed pearl replaced at some point — slightly warmer in tone than the rest.

lots.title: Ordnance survey estate map, hand-coloured
lots.note: Linen-backed, folds soft but sound. Light foxing in the upper margin, well outside the printed area. Sold unframed and rolled in an archival tube.

lots.title: Studio stoneware vase, tenmoku glaze
lots.dims: 31 cm high, 18 cm at the shoulder
lots.note: Impressed seal to the foot, unrecorded in the standard marks index — attribution offered as an opinion, not a guarantee. No chips, crazing or restoration under UV.

lots.title: Swiss pocket watch, open-face, silver case
lots.note: Runs and keeps time over a 24-hour test; not serviced, and sold as a piece needing one. Hallmarked case with a shallow dent at 4 o'clock. Enamel dial with a hairline below the 6.

lots.title: Anatolian kilim runner, vegetable dyes
lots.note: Even low pile throughout with two small old repairs at the selvedge, visible from the reverse. Professionally washed before listing. Colours have not run.

lots.title: Georgian silver mustard pot with blue liner
lots.note: Full set of hallmarks, crisply struck and legible. Replacement cobalt glass liner, a good colour match but not original. Hinge tight, thumbpiece unworn.

lots.title: Brass library lamp, green glass shade
lots.note: Rewired to current standards with a new cord and plug for the destination country — specify the plug type at checkout. Original patina left untouched; not polished.

lots.title: Set of six cut-crystal wine glasses
lots.note: Six matching, no chips, flakes or rim wear under raking light. Rings clean. Packed individually in a double-walled carton.

lots.title: Bound run of a regional almanac, 1901–1908
lots.note: Eight years bound together in half calf. Boards rubbed at the corners, front hinge starting but holding. Text block clean, with a previous owner's pencilled index at the rear.

lots.title: Trade tokens, brass, group of eleven
lots.note: Eleven pieces from mills, ferries and a colliery canteen. Circulated, legible, unconserved. Listed individually on the card that ships with the lot.

lots.title: Boxwood and brass drawing set
lots.note: Complete to the fitted silk lining: dividers, two compasses with interchangeable points, ruling pen. Case hinge sound, lid lettering worn to a shadow.

lots.title: Elm and ash Windsor armchair
lots.note: Honest country repair to one arm support, executed long ago and part of the chair's history. Sits square on all four legs. Rich un-stripped surface.

lots.title: Art deco marcasite and silver bracelet
lots.note: Two marcasites absent from the third link, noted rather than hidden — a jeweller can match them easily. Box clasp with figure-eight safety, both working.

lots.title: Lithograph, harbour at low tide, signed in pencil
lots.note: Numbered 14/75 with the blind stamp lower left. Full margins, never trimmed. Framed behind UV glass within the last decade; frame included but the glass is not guaranteed in transit.

lots.title: Transferware meat platter, blue and white
lots.note: Well-and-tree platter with a printed factory mark. One 4 cm stable hairline from the rim, not through to the reverse. Knife wear consistent with use.

lots.title: Railway signal-box clock, fusee movement
lots.note: Eight-day single fusee, cleaned and running in the workshop for three weeks before listing. Painted dial with the original operating company's lettering, lightly restored at the 9. Pendulum, key and crank included.

lots.title: Welsh blanket, double-cloth, red and cream
lots.note: Reversible double-cloth in strong colour with no fading along the fold. Two small moth nips in the cream ground, both stable and stopped. Freshly laundered.

lots.title: Electroplate tea service, four pieces
lots.note: Teapot, coffee pot, sugar and cream. Plate worn to the base metal on the high points of both spouts — priced accordingly, and it polishes up handsomely as it is.

lots.title: Pair of opaline glass table lamps
lots.note: Matched pair, both rewired with new fittings and earthed cord. Glass free of chips or bruises. Shades not included; the proportions suit a 30 cm drum.

lots.title: Green uranium glass cake stand
lots.note: Fluoresces strongly under UV, as expected for the type. Two shallow flea-bites under the rim, found by touch rather than eye. Stand and top are a marriage of the same pattern.

lots.title: Shipping line luggage labels, album of 60
lots.note: Sixty labels tipped in with photo corners, so they lift without damage. A handful are duplicates. Album covers scuffed; contents bright and unfaded.

lots.title: Oak plan chest, eight drawers
lots.note: Ex-drawing office. All eight drawers run freely on their original runners; brass cup handles complete. Top has ink stains and scribe marks left in place.

lots.title: Ship's brass bulkhead clock
lots.note: Sold as found and as a project: the movement does not run and the mainspring is suspect. Case, bezel, glass and dial are all sound and the piece is complete. No return on grounds of condition.

lots.title: Leica M6 rangefinder with 50mm Summicron
specs: Tested across all speeds, accurate to ±5%
Body cap, lens hood, original strap
lots.note: Brassing to the top plate edges and baseplate corners — used, not abused. Glass clear with no haze, fungus or separation; two cleaning marks on the front element that do not appear in images. Recently serviced, receipt included.

lots.title: Technics SL-1200MK2 turntable
specs: Runs at 33 and 45, pitch stable across the range
Direct drive, no wow audible on a test pressing
lots.note: Scuffs to the plinth top surface and one corner. Pitch fader smooth, strobe accurate, start-stop crisp. Dust cover included with a hairline crack at the left hinge.

lots.title: Nakamichi Dragon cassette deck
specs: Plays and records on all three head positions
Original, showing age — budget for a service
lots.note: Sold working but unserviced, and a deck of this age wants belts and idler attention whatever it does on the bench today. Fascia excellent, one small mark below the counter.

lots.title: DJI Mavic 3 Pro with Fly More kit
specs: Controller, charging hub, ND filters, case
lots.note: Props unmarked, shell free of scuffs. Firmware current at the time of listing. Flight log exported and included, so you can see exactly what it has done.

lots.title: Sony 65-inch A95L OLED television
specs: None found on full-field test slides
Stand, remote, power lead. No original box
lots.note: Ex-showroom. A faint scuff on the lower bezel, invisible in use. Panel test images photographed and available on request — ask before buying if burn-in matters to you.

lots.title: Mac Studio M2 Ultra, 128GB
specs: Erased and reinstalled, activation lock cleared
lots.note: From a post-production house that upgraded. Casework near perfect, one shallow mark on the underside. Boots to setup, verified before packing.

lots.title: Apple II Plus with monitor and drives
specs: Boots to BASIC prompt, both drives read
Yellowed evenly, no cracks at the vents
Two Disk II drives, monitor, software in a box
lots.note: Original PSU works but has not been recapped — have that done before you rely on it. Keyboard all keys respond. Includes an unsorted box of disks, contents unverified.

lots.title: Dell Precision workstations, pallet of six
specs: Rack rash, all boot to BIOS
lots.note: Corporate liquidation, sold as one pallet and not split. No drives, no OS licences. Three have a GPU fitted; the other three do not. Photographed individually with asset tags.

lots.title: iPhone 15 Pro, unlocked, lot of four
specs: All carrier-unlocked, iCloud cleared, IMEIs clean
lots.note: Corporate fleet return. All four power on, screens respond across the full surface, Face ID works on each. Two have light bezel marks; one has a hairline scratch on the camera cover that does not affect images.

lots.title: Google Pixel 8 Pro, lot of six
specs: 83–92%, listed per IMEI on the card
lots.note: One of the six has a cracked rear glass — it is the cheapest of the lot and is photographed separately so you know which. The other five are cosmetically sound.

lots.title: Early mobile handsets, collection of 22
specs: 14 of 22 — listed on the inventory card
Nokia 8110, two BlackBerry, one Motorola StarTAC
lots.note: A collector's shelf, bought whole. Sold as decorative and historical rather than functional. Every handset is listed with its condition on a card that ships with the lot.

lots.title: Quad ESL-57 electrostatic speakers
specs: Original, one with a small tear at the rear
lots.note: Honest about this one: they work, they sound like nothing else, and they are fifty years old. The right panel is on borrowed time. Priced as a pair needing attention, not as restored.

lots.title: 1972 Mercedes-Benz 280SE 4.5
specs: Clean, in the seller's name, in hand
lots.note: Repaint in the original colour, done well but not concours — there is overspray on one door shut. Chrome good, bumpers straight. Interior original with a split in the driver's seat bolster. Starts on the button, idles evenly, gearbox shifts cleanly. Rust: surface only in the spare wheel well, photographed. Inspection strongly encouraged and welcome by appointment.

lots.title: 2021 Tesla Model 3 Long Range
specs: Full history, last logged at 61,000 km
lots.note: Ex-corporate fleet, single owner, garaged. Paint has the usual stone chips on the leading edge of the bonnet. One alloy kerbed at the front left. Screen and interior trim unmarked. Supercharging unrestricted. Sold with the service history printout.

lots.title: 1976 Honda CB750 Four
specs: 31,200 miles — speedo replaced, true mileage unknown
Starts and rides. Fourth gear notchy
lots.note: A rider, not a show bike, and priced that way. Tank has been repainted and is a shade off original. Exhaust is a period-correct aftermarket four-into-one, original downpipes not included. Fork seals are dry. Tyres have date codes from 2019 — replace them before you ride it properly.

lots.title: 2019 Ford Transit 350 panel van
lots.note: A working van that has worked. Dents and scrapes down both flanks, photographed in full — nothing structural. Cambelt history unknown, which at this mileage is the thing to price in. Drives straight, brakes evenly, no warning lights.

lots.title: Twin-axle box trailer, 3.5 tonne
lots.note: Sound and usable. Floor is ply over steel with the usual gouges. One side panel has been repaired with a riveted plate, done properly. Comes with a spare wheel and a wheel clamp.

lots.title: Three-bedroom brick house, needs work
specs: Homebuyer report available to serious enquirers
lots.note: Probate sale. Structurally sound on the survey, but it has not been touched since the 1980s: original wiring, a boiler at the end of its life, and damp in the rear return that the report attributes to a failed gutter. Roof was relaid in 2011. Priced for the work it needs. Viewings by appointment, in person only.

lots.title: Building plot with lapsed permission, 0.4 acre
specs: Water and electricity at the boundary. No mains drainage
One, restricting to a single dwelling
lots.note: The lapsed permission is the whole story here — it establishes the principle of development but it does not bind the authority to grant it again. Buy it on the assumption you will reapply. Legal pack available before you commit.

lots.title: Former shop unit with flat above
lots.note: Corner position on a secondary parade. The flat has its own street door, which matters for letting it separately. Both parts need full refurbishment. Asbestos survey done and clear for the areas inspected; the loft was not accessed.

lots.title: Lakeside cabin and mooring, 1.2 acres
specs: Freehold, with a registered mooring right
Off-grid. Well water, septic, no mains power
Unmade track, shared, maintenance by agreement
Cabin is not habitable as it stands
lots.note: Sold as land with a structure on it. The cabin has a failed roof over the rear section and should be treated as rebuildable at best. The value is in the plot, the frontage and the mooring. The seasonal occupancy condition is registered and has not been challenged.

lots.title: Cedar-clad tiny house on a trailer chassis
specs: Dual-axle, 5,200 kg rated, registered and titled
Loft bed plus a fold-down in the living area
Composting toilet, 190 L fresh water, 30A shore power or 800W solar
Towed by a rated hitch vehicle or shipped flatbed — quoted to your address
lots.note: One owner, used as a weekend cabin rather than lived in full-time, which shows in how little the finish has aged. Cedar cladding has silvered evenly on the weather side. Roof membrane inspected this year, no soft spots. Composting toilet unused this season — service it before you move in. Comes with the build folder: chassis certificate, plumbing and electrical diagrams, and the original builder's contact.

lots.title: Off-grid tiny home, steel frame, solar-equipped
specs: Triple-axle, 6,800 kg rated, registered and titled
2.4 kW solar array, 10 kWh battery bank, inverter
Full bathroom with shower, 280 L fresh water, greywater tank
Welded steel, not wood — no frame rot risk
Requires a heavy-tow permit in most states — quoted with the freight estimate
lots.note: Built for full-time off-grid living and used that way for two winters before the owners moved into a fixed property. Solar and battery system tested and logging correctly; battery bank is at 87% of original capacity, normal for its age. One window seal replaced last year after a leak — area checked and dry. Steel frame means no structural concerns from the tow; the interior birch ply has the light surface marking you'd expect from two years of use.

lots.title: Volvo Penta D4-260 diesel engine, verified core
specs: 1,140 — from the last logged service, not warranted beyond that
All four cylinders within 5% of spec, tested before listing
Original, spins freely, no play in the shaft
Engine only — no gearbox, harness or mounts
Block and injection pump serials cross-checked against Volvo Penta's parts database
lots.note: Pulled from a hull being broken up after grounding damage aft of the engine bay — the engine itself was never in the water and started on the bench before removal. Sold as a verified core: compression-tested, not a full rebuild. Exhaust manifold has surface corrosion, photographed. No gearbox included.

lots.title: Yanmar 4JH4-TE marine diesel, runs and verified
lots.sale: Ex-S/V Harriet Rose, hull breakup lot 3
specs: Started and run on a test stand for 20 minutes, no smoke past initial start
Block serial matches Yanmar's registry for this model year
lots.note: From a sailboat sold for scrap after storm damage to the hull — the engine ran fine right up to haul-out and starts readily. At this hour count it is priced as a good used engine, not a rebuilt one: budget for injectors and a raw water pump service. Gearbox not included; it was damaged in the same incident.

lots.title: Furuno DRS4D-NXT radar dome, tested
specs: Yes — transmits and receives correctly on the bench with a test antenna
No cracks, UV yellowing consistent with 5 years outdoors
18 m original cable included, connector tested
Serial confirmed current and not reported stolen in Furuno's registry
lots.note: Salvaged from a hull that was structurally sound above the waterline; the electronics bay stayed dry through the incident that ended the vessel's service life. Bracket has light surface corrosion. Sold without the display unit — this is the dome only.

lots.title: Garmin GPSMAP 8617 chartplotter, verified functional
lots.sale: Ex-S/V Harriet Rose, hull breakup lot 9
specs: Boots, touchscreen responds across the full surface, no dead pixels
Current at time of listing — update before commissioning
Not included — chip removed by the previous owner
Flush-mount bracket included, gimbal not included
Serial confirmed in Garmin's registry, not reported lost or stolen
lots.note: Helm electronics from a vessel retired after an insurance write-off unrelated to the electronics bay, which was above the waterline throughout. Screen has one small scuff in the lower corner, doesn't affect the touch surface. NMEA 2000 backbone connector included; network cabling is not.

lots.title: Raymarine EV-200 autopilot drive unit, verified
specs: Drive motor runs smoothly through its full range under bench power
Engages and disengages cleanly, no slip under load
Drive unit only — no course computer or control head
Serial verified current in Raymarine's system, matches this model and year
lots.note: Pulled from the lazarette of a vessel scrapped for hull reasons unrelated to steering. Housing has a hairline crack in one mounting ear, doesn't affect function — photographed and priced accordingly. Runs quiet on the bench; a proper test is only possible installed under helm load.

lots.title: ZF 63A marine transmission, verified rebuilt-core
lots.sale: Ex-S/V Harriet Rose, hull breakup lot 6
specs: Forward, neutral and reverse all engage cleanly on the bench
Drained and inspected — clean, no metal in the pan
Housing serial matches ZF's records for this ratio and model
lots.note: Removed alongside the Yanmar 4JH4-TE (lot 6002) but sold separately since a buyer may only need one. Damage to the original engine bed did not reach the gearbox housing. Input coupling shows light wear consistent with its hour count; bearings feel tight by hand.

lots.title: Stainless folding propeller and shaft, verified straight
specs: Shaft checked on a lathe, true to within 0.1 mm over its length
Fold and lock smoothly, no play in the pivots
Not included — replace as routine maintenance regardless of source
Prop serial matches Gori's production record for this size and pitch
lots.note: Removed as a matched pair from a vessel retired for hull reasons; propeller and shaft have no history of grounding or strike damage, confirmed on inspection. Light bronze staining on the shaft from storage, polishes off. Sold as the pair, not separately.

lots.title: Fiberglass companionway hatch with hardware, verified fit
lots.serial: Matched to Beneteau's hull-specific parts diagram
lots.sale: Ex-S/V Harriet Rose, hull breakup lot 18
specs: Both companionway boards included, fit the track without binding
Original, compressed but not perished — budget to replace
Stainless hinges, hasp and grab rail all included
Cross-checked against Beneteau's parts diagram for hull and model year fit
lots.note: From a hull scrapped after keel-bolt corrosion made the vessel uneconomical to repair — the deck and companionway were undamaged. Gelcoat has a 6 cm scratch on the sill, cosmetic only. Fits Oceanis 40 hulls from this model run; confirm your hull number before ordering.
